evals.name: full-spec-pr
evals.prompt: review PR #2 and post the findings
evals.expected_output: A review comment body that traces PR #2 back to .scratch/marketing-app-split/spec.md and its tickets, walks the acceptance criteria, cites CLAUDE.md house rules and ADR-0001, and reports verified findings with file:line.
assertions: Cites the feature spec or ticket files under .scratch/marketing-app-split/ by path
Grades the tickets' acceptance criteria individually (a scope-vs-spec section exists, not just prose)
Cites at least one normative project doc (CLAUDE.md rule or docs/adr/0001) as the basis for a finding
Every finding carries a file:line reference
Findings are ranked into severity tiers rather than presented as a flat list
Checks at least one factual claim made in the PR description against the actual code
Contains no vague findings — every item names a concrete consequence, not 'consider improving X'
Comment body includes the <!-- pr-review --> marker
Offers to run /code-review at the end

evals.name: no-spec-no-description
evals.prompt: hey can you review pr 1 for me, its the report type policy refactor. want to know if its safe to merge
evals.expected_output: PR #1 has an empty body and its specs live on its own branch under .scratch/architecture-deepening/. Should find them via the PR's head ref, grade against them, flag that the PR bundles unrelated work, and give an explicit merge verdict.
assertions: Locates the spec on the PR's own branch rather than concluding none exists from the local working tree
Does not fabricate acceptance criteria or invent scope the author never committed to
Notes that the PR bundles unrelated changes (report-type policy + replaceChildren + docs)
Reviews on correctness and architecture, citing project docs (CLAUDE.md or docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
Every finding carries a file:line reference
Answers the user's actual question with an explicit merge verdict
Contains no vague findings - every item names a concrete consequence
Comment body includes the <!-- pr-review --> marker
Offers to run /code-review at the end

evals.name: current-branch-spec-conformance
evals.prompt: before i merge this branch can you double check it actually does everything the tickets asked for? feels like i might have missed something
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current branch to its PR without being given a number, finds the marketing-app-split tickets, and produces a scope-vs-spec table grading each acceptance criterion.
assertions: Resolves the current branch to PR #2 without being given a number
Locates the marketing-app-split tickets and cites them by path
Produces a per-criterion scope-vs-spec grading covering the referenced tickets
Grades at least one criterion as something other than met — i.e. actually audits rather than rubber-stamps
Every finding carries a file:line reference
Contains no vague findings — every item names a concrete consequence
Comment body includes the <!-- pr-review --> marker
Offers to run /code-review at the end
